meta.name: understand-figma
meta.description: Analyze a Figma file via the Figma REST API and generate an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, design tokens) with a kind:"design" dashboard.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 Figma 文件并生成交互式设计知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从 Figma 设计稿中提取结构化信息
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Figma files and generate an interactive design knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to extract structured information from Figma designs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能分析 Figma 文件，生成包含页面、组件、设计令牌等元素的设计知识图谱，并自动打开交互式仪表盘。
howto.when: 当你提供 Figma 文件链接或密钥，并设置好 Figma 个人访问令牌时触发。

say.text: 用中文分析 Figma 文件 key 为 def456 的设计
say.note: 指定语言为中文，结果会以中文呈现。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze a Figma file and generate an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, components, design tokens, etc.), then auto-launch a dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a Figma file URL or key and have set the FIGMA_TOKEN environment variable.

say_en.note: Claude fetches the file and generates a knowledge graph.

say_en.text: Analyze Figma file key def456 in Chinese
